text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-san.
Won't you stay and hang out a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Bubble Gum Fellow gestured toward
an atmospheric amusement arcade.
choice_data_list: Sounds great, absolutely!
Sounds good, definitely!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I come to places like this sometimes.
My father taught me all sorts of games
since I was little, you see."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Darts, mahjong, poker, hanafuda...
I love 'em all, but today I'm in the mood for—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Maybe this one?
Trainer, are you good at billiards?
choice_data_list: I've done it before, but that's about it...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see, then let's start with a review.
I'll teach you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I grip the cue and hit a few balls.
As I play casually while being taught,
my feel for the game gradually returns!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, not bad, not bad at all!
Hehe, now I'm getting fired up.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Well, how about we get serious now?
Nine-ball. One rack to start, how's that sound?
choice_data_list: Yeah... Let's do it!
Yeah... let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's get banking right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nine-ball is a game where you aim for
the balls in order, starting from the lowest number.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first player to pocket the 9-ball wins.
Before long, they were down to the 5-ball.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Ngh! Ah, couldn't sink it into the pocket, huh!
Your turn next, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Alright! Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "This ball arrangement...! If I can bounce the cue ball off the opposite cushion just right, I should be able to hit the 5 into the 9 and sink it in the pocket."
choice_data_list: (This is a huge chance. We can do this...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: You noticed, huh...? *giggle*

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you confident we can win?
choice_data_list: ...*gasp*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being asked makes me startle.
Because I couldn't answer immediately,
even though my heart felt, "I can do this!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, just the other day too...
I was certain of it, yet I couldn't bring myself to say it out loud.
choice_data_list: I—
I, uh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to be able to say it.
Just like Bubble Gum Fellow...!
I took a light breath and parted my lips.
choice_data_list: I'll sink the 9-ball and beat you!
I will sink the 9-ball and defeat you!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hold the cue and focus my mind.
It's okay. I can do this...
Because "I know I can"—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BONK! Clack, clack... THUD!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Splendid...!
choice_data_list: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ah ha ha ha! You look so happy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was truly exhilarating.
To see something through exactly as promised... I never knew it could bring such a sense of pride.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, are you starting to act like me?
Just kidding♪"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You're so dependable right now.
It's really cool.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Being told that so shamelessly makes my cheeks burn.
I guess I really have changed, even if just a little...!"
choice_data_list: Saying it out loud is important, huh.
Saying it out loud is important, isn't it?
I was able to win today thanks to you!
I was able to win today thanks to you!
I'll keep working even harder from now on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Being told that so shamelessly makes my cheeks burn.
I guess I really have changed, even if just a little...!"
choice_data_list: Saying it out loud is important, huh.
Saying it out loud is important, isn't it?
I was able to win today thanks to you!
I was able to win today thanks to you!
I'll keep working even harder from now on!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
I'm sure you understand by now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm declaring it because I know I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod deeply at those words.
I felt as though I had gained a renewed, deeper understanding of Bubble Gum Fellow's indomitable spirit.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Thanks to me...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Could that be about the amusement park or the BBQ?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's your influence.
Right, it's your influence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being with Bubble Gum Fellow makes me want to stand tall
alongside her cool self.
That helped me grow just a little bit.
choice_data_list: So... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Chuckle.
I didn't do anything at all.
If anything has changed, that's your own power.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to the strength of the Trainer I chose and believed in!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm counting on you.
I'll have to do my best to live up to your expectations too♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
First, I'm going to beat you this time!
Let's go for one more match!
choice_data_list: Just what I wanted!
Just what I wanted!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we played games right up until curfew.
A heated, serious match...!
I was truly happy to have a relationship where we could do that.
